REQUEST TEST: Peripheral_Blood_Smear
The combination of fever, bone pain, and cytopenias with high white count is highly suspicious for acute leukemia; the smear will help identify blast cells.

speaker: Doctor
text: A normal peripheral smear is unusual with such high white blood cells, so I need to see the cells under higher magnification to confirm if they are blasts. REQUEST TEST: Bone_Marrow_Biopsy
